name: Love's Gift
summary: In Orgrimmar, Gan'rul Bloodeye awaits a pendant for the succubus rite. Dogran gives up a treasured keepsake after being found and revived in the Barrens.

sections.title: A Grunt's Sacrifice
sections.body: Grunt Dogran was held and tortured by the Bristleback quilboar in the Barrens. Ken'zigla's draught brings him back to consciousness, but his body cannot recover. He chooses to meet death in battle rather than return to his mate, Zankaja, unable to fight. Dogran gives up a dirt-caked pendant, a gift born of love, and asks that Zankaja never learn what he surrendered.

sections.title: Bait for a Demon
sections.body: A warlock needs a talisman charged with strong, unblemished emotion to summon and control a succubus. These demons feed on mortal desire and twist genuine affection into anguish. Dogran's pendant bears his devotion and their parting. Bring it to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar's shadowy clefts, where it is cleaned and polished. Its bright emotional force can draw the soul-devourer across the Twisting Nether.

faq.q: Why does a warlock need Dogran's pendant?
faq.answer: Succubi are drawn to deep mortal passions, which they twist and consume. Dogran's pendant holds selfless love and sacrifice, making it a potent lure for a succubus.

Grunt Dogran is a Horde warrior captured and tortured by the Bristleback quilboar in the southern Barrens. An alchemical tonic revives him, but his injuries leave him unable to live as a proud warrior.
Zankaja is Dogran's young mate, who waited anxiously for news of him. He gives up her token and chooses to seek a warrior's death rather than burden her with caring for him.

faq.q: Why does Dogran ask you to keep this secret from Zankaja?
faq.answer: Dogran does not want his young mate bound to a dying invalid. He gives up her pendant, knowing it will not return to her, and asks that she be spared the guilt of learning how his fate ended.

faq.q: Who cleans the pendant and why?
faq.answer: Gan'rul Bloodeye, the warlock trainer in Orgrimmar, takes the pendant and cleans away its filth. Its bright appearance and emotional force can then draw the summoned demon.

faq.q: What happens immediately after completing this quest?
faq.answer: Gan'rul Bloodeye sends you to carry the purified pendant into the summoning circle beneath Orgrimmar. There you cast the binding rite and face the succubus alone.

angles.text: As a warlock, you learn that arcane power alone cannot bind a demon. A succubus can be ensnared by turning its hunger for mortal passions like love and grief against it.
As a member of the Horde, you see Grunt Dogran choose death in battle over life as a burden to his kin.
